stories.title: Create BEV C02 Performance Assessment with Battery System Fault Isolation Rubrics
stories.description: Develop practical performance assessment for C02 (Battery & HV Systems) with three real-world fault scenarios, integrated safety checkpoints, and decision-tree rubrics for BMS diagnostics, HV cable testing, and OBC troubleshooting aligned to NOSS C02 CoCU assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: File bev-diagnostic-rectification/c02-battery-system/PA.md created with 3 complete fault scenarios (low cell voltage, BMS communication loss, HV cable insulation failure) each with context, task, measurement guide, and isolation decision tree

Each scenario includes ≥2 safety checkpoints, pass/fail rubric with point allocation, and specific measurement tolerances referenced (e.g., ≥100MΩ insulation, cell voltage ≥2.5V) matching industry standards for EV battery diagnostics

Cross-references bev-diagnostic-rectification/c02-battery-system/KK-01.md and KK-02.md for tool specifications; includes bilingual terms (EN: battery management system, BM: sistem pengurusan bateri) consistent with 00-bilingual-glossary.md
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/c02-battery-system/PA.md with structure [Scenario 1-3] containing {Fault Context | Required Measurements | Decision Tree | Safety Checkpoints | Evaluation Rubric}
Validate against NOSS G452-010-3:2023 C02 CoCU assessment criteria for battery pack and HV system diagnostics

Test command: grep -c 'Safety Checkpoint' bev-diagnostic-rectification/c02-battery-system/PA.md (expected: ≥6); grep -E '[0-9]+MΩ|[0-9]+V' bev-diagnostic-rectification/c02-battery-system/PA.md (expected: ≥8 measurement thresholds)
stories._rejection_reason: too_simple: only 1 measurable ACs -- specify test commands, file paths, or numeric thresholds
